method: PINVIT eigenvalue extraction -> Foster -> Cauer-I (ATTEMPTED, FAILED)
comments: PINVIT gave 30 eigenmodes with eigenvalues [1700, 20000] and beta^2 [1e-22, 1e-19].
But Foster Y(0) = sum |beta|^2 / (sigma * lambda^2) needs Parseval sum_beta^2 = V = 1e-8.
30 modes give sum_beta^2 ~ 1e-18, off by 10 orders of magnitude.
Mathematica reference uses 250000 modes; PINVIT cannot realistically reach that count.
CONCLUSION: PINVIT approach fundamentally insufficient at practical mesh sizes.
Kameari recursion (with tree-cotree + HH) remains the practical path.
Trade-off: Kameari good Stage 0-7 (2-13 digits), broken Stage 9+ from cancellation.
foster_R: [Stored modes show R_F values 1e10 to 1e14, beta^2 1e-19 to 1e-22, all wildly off]
